scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.dev: sh -c 'npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend; wait'
scripts.stop:backend: sh -c 'pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:3001 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "Stopping backend on port 3001: $pids"; kill $pids; fi'
scripts.stop:frontend: sh -c 'for port in 5173 5174; do pids=$(lsof -tiTCP:$port -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "Stopping frontend on port $port: $pids"; kill $pids; fi; done'
scripts.stop:dev: npm run stop:backend && npm run stop:frontend
scripts.restart:dev: npm run stop:dev && npm run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run stop:frontend && npm run dev --prefix cyberscout
scripts.dev:backend: npm run stop:backend && npm run db:migrate --prefix cyberscout-server && npm run dev --prefix cyberscout-server
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
